Dialogs.Dialog: All right, time for another day of library duty... Oh！
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
So you didn't quit the library committee.
Straight to that, huh...
...Hey.
Hm？
It's distracting when you space out over there.
I'm kind of bored... Got any fun books I can read fast？
The elementary school reading list.
Huh, you keep those here？
At the town children's library.
Hey... can't you be a little more fun？
Nope. Anyway, reading's plenty of fun for me.
Then I'll read something too. Any recommendations？
Huh, you keep those... Hey, is this conversation going to loop？
Yep.
(Good grief...)
All right, time for another day of library duty...
Not that there's anything to do... I'm bored...
Kobayakawa
Your phone's ringing.
Sigh...
What？
...So just go, the three of you. That way nobody has to tiptoe around anybody.
...You don't have to act all worried. Rinko gets by on her own. Bye.
Is that okay？ If you had plans or something...
Ugh, quit bugging me！
Hey！
▲小早川＊▲'s taking a while... I need to close the library soon.
Where did ▲小早川＊▲ go...？
Sniff...
!? ...Is someone crying？
...What？
Oh, I figured we should lock up soon. You've got the key, right？
Yeah.
...Hey, just now...
You can go home first. I'll lock up and head out.
(▲小早川＊▲... She was crying, right？)
(Got a little late today...)
Kobayakawa
Ugh, leave me alone already！
(!? Wait... That's ▲小早川＊▲, isn't it？)
Sketchy Guy
Hey, get back here！
(And there's some sketchy-looking guy with her...)
!! Perfect timing！
Who the hell're you？ Her boyfriend？
Yeah. We're in the middle of a date.
Huh!? W-We are？
Of course we are！ And he's super strong, you know！
Wait... who's "he"？
You！ Go on, clobber him— kaboom！
Oh yeah...？ Feel like going "kaboom," buddy？
Hold on, what does "kaboom" even mean...
You want a piece of me, punk!!
▲小早川＊▲, run！
Huh？
Okay... So let me get this straight. You were playing a fighting game at the arcade, and he challenged you.
Kobayakawa
Yeah.
And after you wiped the floor with him, he picked a fight.
Right.
And then ▲小早川＊▲ did what？
I kicked him.
Don't kick people！
He wouldn't quit！ It was self-defense. I'm a delicate girl, you know？ You should've fought him instead of running. Aren't you a guy？
That would just get the police involved, right？
Yeah, thinking back, it does kind of bug me...
And if I lost, what would happen to ▲小早川＊▲？
You were just scared.
Right？ A guy should go in swinging. Kaboom！
Sheesh, talking like you're so much older.
Well, I guess I should thank you, at least.
Yeah, yeah... So, what now？
Just so you know！ That date thing earlier was just something I said on the spot to...
No... I meant it's late, so I'll walk you home. That guy might still be around.
Oh. Well, that's fine, then...
Hey...
You could have pretended not to know me, or just run off on your own.
Why didn't you？
Why？ I just... did it without thinking.
Hmm...
...This is my house.
Okay. ...See you, then.
...Yeah.
All right, time for another day of library duty！
Oh！
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Hey.
(Work's done for today. Now I just wait for closing time, like always...)
(▲小早川＊▲ is the same as always... Like that other night never happened...)
(She's cute when she's quiet like this... Big eyes, long lashes, and her cheeks...)
Hey.
Whoa!? N-No, sorry!!
...Were you thinking something pervy？
No way！ ...So, what is it？
I'm going to the arcade after this today.
Oh. ...Wait, won't you run into that guy again？
Yeah. That's why.
Phew... I'll go easy on you for today！
▲小早川＊▲... You're a hardcore gamer, huh. Fighting games especially.
Kind of. I've been coming here a lot lately.
If you want to take on Ri... me, you'll have to get a lot better, okay？
Sorry... Should we head home？ Want me to walk you？
Huh？ Um... I'm good today.
But it's pretty late already, right？
Quit acting so grown-up. Bye！
Oh, hey！
(She's gone... Is she gonna be okay？)
All right, time for bed！
...I'm kind of hungry... Convenience store run！
(Mackerel, mackerel... There. I'll splurge on the gold label！)
Kobayakawa
There's a high schooler buying canned mackerel in the middle of the night...
What are you doing here？
I got hungry, so I came to grab something. I live nearby.
So, canned mackerel？ What are you, a salaryman？
What's wrong with it？ DHA！ What are you doing here, ▲小早川＊▲？
Um... I was out for a walk and ended up here？
It's not exactly walking time... And you're still in your uniform.
None of your business. Why don't you go home and sleep？
You too, ▲小早川＊▲. I'll walk you.
Leave me alone, you nosy old man.
I'm one year older！ ...I can't just leave you out at this hour.
Hey, wait！
Clerk
Hey, sir！ You need to pay！
Huh!? Oh, um... ▲小早川＊▲！
Thank you very much.
(I lost her... I hope ▲小早川＊▲ is okay...)
All right, time for another day of library duty！
(▲小早川＊▲'s absent, huh... I hope nothing happened to her.)
▲小早川＊▲！ What are you doing here at this hour... and in casual clothes...？
Kobayakawa
Not really？
(Could it be she hasn't gone home...？ She was still in her uniform at the convenience store...)
(Does this have something to do with her crying on the roof...？)
(Still, if she came all the way to the library, maybe she's counting on me...)
(Am I overthinking it？ ...Still, though... All right！)
Hey, are you free this Sunday？
...Why？
Well, uh... How about we go on a date or something？
A... a date...？ Between who and who？
▲小早川＊▲ and... me？
...What are you talking about？ Are you stupid...？
R-Right... Yeah, I figured.
...Did you say Sunday？
Yeah.
I guess I wouldn't mind... going with you.
Really？
It's not a date or anything！ Look... we're just going out somewhere.
That's fine by me. Let's just go out somewhere, then.
Ahh... Spring's so nice and warm, huh？
Kobayakawa
For old people.
I'm one year older... Hey, since we came on this da...
"Da"？
...Day out together, can't you have a little more fun？
Nope.
I see... Still, it feels great out！
Yeah... It hasn't changed at all since back then.
You used to come here a lot？
When I was little. The three of us, with a packed lunch... Let's go over there？
Hey... I might be butting in, but is something bothering you？
Not really.
I see... It's okay if you don't want to talk about it.
Today... my new mom and little brother are over at our house.
New... you mean...
My dad's remarrying. It's complicated. Got it？
Then shouldn't you be at home all the more...
You don't get it... Things go better when the extra one stays out of the way.
When I'm around, everyone gets all gloomy.
So today I'm just killing time. Happy now？
I'm not getting gloomy
Is there anything I can do？
Yeah, happy
So "everyone" isn't right.
I'm nosy, remember？
For now, anyway. I'm glad you told me even a little.
See you. ...You're going straight home, right？
If you don't promise, I'll walk you all the way...
I'll go home！
Good. ...I'll listen anytime you want to talk. Let's go on another da... I mean, outing, okay？
Nosy old man...
I'm only a year older, though！
(Maybe I should've walked her home after all...)
Whew, it's hot... The sun's brutal！
Kobayakawa
How are you so full of energy...
'Cause it's a date？ ...More importantly, ▲小早川＊▲, are you okay？
I'm not okay, and it's not a date...
...Then let's go sit in the shade over there. It's full of families, though.
No.
But...
I hate families on outings.
I see.
I'm gonna die like this. I'm getting ice cream...
Hey, wait！
It's cooled off a bit... Sorry about that. Kind of dragged you out here.
It's fine. I couldn't stay home anyway.
I've been wondering for a while... Is something bothering you？
Not really. ...My new mom and little brother are just over at the house.
New... you mean...
My dad's remarrying. That's all.
I see... Then shouldn't you be home all the more...
The extra one stays outside. That's the trick to making it work.
So I'm the one who dragged YOU along. Thanks for your trouble. Happy now？
I don't feel dragged along
That's not okay at all！
Yeah, okay
I wanted to talk with ▲小早川＊▲.
Are you really okay with that, ▲小早川＊▲？
I wanted to hear about it. That's why.
See you. Go straight home, okay？
If you don't promise, I'll walk you home.
I'll go home！
Good. ...I'll listen anytime you want to talk. Let's go on another da... I mean, outing, okay？
Nosy old man...
I'm only a year older, though！
(Maybe I should've walked her home after all...)
If you're talking classic dates, it's gotta be the zoo, right？
Kobayakawa
It smells like animals... Also, did you say "date"？
Must be your imagination. What do you want to see, ▲小早川＊▲？
I don't want to see anything.
Come on... There's gotta be something. Elephants, giraffes...？
Pass. Big ones are scary.
Then how about rabbits？
Their eyes are scary.
Um, then...
I'm going to see the ocelots.
The oce-what？ ...Hey, wait！
You know this zoo pretty well, huh？ ...Though I think we only saw cats.
Kind of. When I was little, the three of us used to...
...Used to？
Never mind...
I've been wondering... Did something happen today？
Not really. ...My new mom and little brother are just over at the house.
New... you mean...
My dad's remarrying. You could figure that out.
I see... But then, today, out here...
That's why I came out here. When Rinko's around, everyone gets all gloomy.
The extra one stays outside. Don't you get that？
I'm not getting gloomy
Don't call yourself extra
I see. Got it
So "everyone" isn't right, is it？
Because that's just wrong！
Are you really okay with that, ▲小早川＊▲？
See you. Go straight home, okay？
If you don't promise, I'll walk you home.
I'll go home！
Good. ...I'll listen anytime you want to talk. Let's go on another da... I mean, outing, okay？
Nosy old man...
I'm only a year older, though！
(Maybe I should've walked her home after all...)
I figured it'd feel all youthful, but... it's freezing！
Kobayakawa
Is it？ I think it feels great！
O-Oh... We can go somewhere else if you want？
I like it here！
Oh... okay.
The sea in winter is nice. Nobody around.
Well, sure. Not when it's this cold.
Geez... Then why don't you just go home！
I can't do that in the middle of a date...
Hm？ Did you say "date"？
Your imagination...
I'm gonna go find crabs！
The wind's dying down. Thank goodness...
Rough on an old man, huh？
I'm one year older... But you looked like you had fun today.
I was wondering if it was okay to drag you out.
...My new mom and little brother are over at the house today.
New... you mean...
My dad's remarrying. Things at home are a little complicated. That's all.
Then maybe I shouldn't have asked you out...
I'd just be killing time somewhere anyway. Rinko's the extra one, after all.
Thanks to you, I think they got to have a nice time, too.
Are you really okay with that？
Don't call yourself extra
I guess it worked out, then
I don't think anyone sees it that way...
Because that's just wrong！
Everyone had a nice time, so it's all good, right？
See you. Go straight home, okay？
If you don't promise, I'll walk you home.
I'll go home！
Good. ...I'll listen anytime you want to talk. Let's go on another da... I mean, outing, okay？
Nosy old man...
I'm only a year older, though！
(Maybe I should've walked her home after all...)
It's this late already... Guess I'll go to bed！
...Or not. This is about when ▲小早川＊▲ was at the convenience store... I have a bad feeling.
And a hungry stomach... I'll go check.
Kobayakawa
Oh...
See, I knew it！ ...Why are you out this late again...
What about you？ They sell canned mackerel everywhere！
Only this place has the gold label！ ...What are you doing？
Like I said, none of your business. Buy your mackerel and go home？
You too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Come on, I'll walk you.
No. I'm staying.
No, you're not.
Leave me alone！ Go away！
Hey, one question.
You're seriously pushy. Did you know that？
Pretty much. I've got one question too.
...What？
Is it hard to be at home？ You came straight from school, didn't you？
So what if I did？ That's my business.
And worrying is my business.
Whenever you feel like talking, you can tell me.
...This is far enough.
Okay. I was sweating the whole way that we'd get picked up for curfew.
Well, good night.
▲主人公＊▲, hey...
Never mind... Don't get picked up on your way back, either.
(She's right... Better hurry home！)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, that book you read sometimes. What's it about？
Kobayakawa
...You wouldn't get it if I told you.
Aw, don't say that. What's it about？
Sigh... It's about how everyone in the world except the hero and his little sister is a brainless idiot.
That's pretty extreme...
That's why I said you wouldn't get it.
And you get it, ▲小早川＊▲？
I get it. Me, I don't need anybody. I'm fine alone.
Why？
Because in my world, everyone's an enemy.
Enemies... That's not true, is it？
It is. I'm the extra one wherever I go.
I stick out like crazy at school, too. So everyone's an enemy.
Thinking like that... must be hard.
Totally fine. Bring it on. The world VS. Rinko... It's kind of exciting.
...Then why would someone who's fine be crying？
!! ...Nobody's crying.
You were crying. On the roof...
I wasn't！ ...I'm going home.
It's this late already... Guess I'll go to bed！
Huh？ A text from ▲小早川＊▲...
They came out with a canned mackerel called Premium Gold. Rinko
Huh, Premium Gold... But why text me at this hour... Oh!!
Huff, huff... ▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
It's called Premium Gold... Did you know？
Did something happen？
...Nothing.
Don't "nothing" me！ Look how late it is...
Clerk
Excuse me... You're disturbing the other customers...
Huh？ Oh, sorry...
Um... are you mad？
I'm not mad. You needed something from me, right？
Yeah... Hey, let's go somewhere on Sunday, okay？
Yeah, sure.
Yeah... That's all.
Wait... You went through all this trouble just for that？
Well, if I called and you were asleep, I'd feel bad...
Wake me up, then！ What if I hadn't noticed your text？
See, you are mad...
I'm not mad, just don't do anything reckless...
Um...
Thanks.
Yeah. See you later, then.
(Things must be awkward at home again...)
The amusement park！ The classic of classics for a da...
Kobayakawa
"Da"？
...So！ What should we ride first？
That one, that one over there！
Hey, don't run！
The teacups... You're not supposed to spin them that hard...
So old-man-ish... We came all this way, so you'd better have fun, right？
Yeah, I guess. Hey...
Hm？
Were they over today too？ Your new mom and all.
Yeah...
You hate her that much...？ Is she mean to you or something？
No way... She's a really nice person. She seems to really love my hopeless dad, too...
And she worries about Rinko a lot.
The one who's in the wrong is always Rinko.
Then maybe a little more...
I can't. I can't smile in front of them.
Because Mama... the mama who gave birth to Rinko... I feel so bad for her.
Hey, about ▲小早川＊▲'s world you told me about.
...Huh？
It's okay to have at least one ally in it, right？ Then I'll be that ally.
So... don't go crying alone. Okay？
...Okay.
Can I say one thing？
What？
You're seriously, seriously nosy, you know that？ Like a guardian or something.
Sometimes I feel like I got myself a reckless little sister...
Then... would you be happy if I called you "big brother"？
Big brother!?
I'd love it！
No thanks
Well, that's kind of embarrassing, I mean...
I'm not gonna call you that.
Oh. Okay.
Big brother, huh... Yeah, I kind of like that.
Right？ I see, I see...
...Lolicon？
(I had a feeling that was coming...)
No. I'll have to pass on that one.
What？ Why not！ You're no fun, big brother！
(She's toying with me...)
Try telling your family what you told me. If anything happens, we'll figure it out together, okay？
Okay, got it. ...Hey？
Today was Rinko's first date ever. ...That's all. See you.
Oh, uh... See you...
(That's kind of embarrassing...)
Well, I guess it's about time for bed...
Hm？ From ▲小早川＊▲...
Not buying mackerel tonight？ I'll wait at the store. Rinko
At this hour... Did something happen after all？
Huff, huff... ▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
Hehe... You came.
Did... something happen？
Sorry, I made you worry. It's okay. I told them I'd be home soon.
But you're out this late again...
This is the last time. I just wanted to see you and tell you right away...
I see... So you got your feelings across, huh.
Yeah. They said I don't have to smile, but let's try living together as a family. ...They cried.
Your dad and your new mom are good people.
Yeah. It made Rinko realize she's still just a kid.
Thanks. I'm fine from here.
So this is the last of our night walks, huh？
Hehe... Gonna miss it a little？
Kind of. But we'll see each other again soon.
Yeah. True... You know, that side of you is something Rinko really...
Sorry, one sec.
Hello？ Yeah, I'm fine. I'm right outside the house. ...Yes, yes. Bye.
From home？
Yeah. Telling me to hurry home.
Makes sense. Well, good night.
Good night！
"That side of me is"... what？ Now I'm curious...
Excuse me！ I'm here to return the library key！
Teacher
Oh, you. Perfect timing.
Yes？ Me？
Sorry, but could you help me make some copies？ It'll only take about ten minutes.
Sure, I guess.
Ten minutes, my foot... It's practically night... Huh？
▲小早川＊▲... I thought you went home... Were you... waiting for me？
Kobayakawa
No！ ...I was just kind of thinking about stuff, and it got this late...
"Kind of thinking"... at the school gate？
That happens, doesn't it...
Well... I guess it does？
So picky. You'll age faster. Come on, let's go！
Maybe it's just me, but I think this is the first time I've walked you home at a normal hour.
Hehe, maybe. Thanks.
Well, see you？
Yeah. ...Hey, it's nice having someone to say 'see you' to.
Yeah. I hope you make lots of friends like that.
Yeah... But for a while, just one is enough for Rinko.
Never mind. See you！
Yeah, see you！
Oh, it's this late already...
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, want to hit the arcade on the way home？
You sure love that place... Well, let's go！
We're here！ So, what am I gonna crush you at today？ Oh...
Hey, let's just go home. That guy from before is here...
Sigh... I see. ▲小早川＊▲, go on home first.
Why？ ...Wait, what are you thinking!?
Sketchy Guy
Oh, you're the guy from before！
Yeah. Um... You can punch me once, so can we call it all even？
Oh？ That's admirable of you. Let's take it outside.
He punched me twice... Ow...
Ugh, I don't get it at all！ Are you a masochist or something？
That's why I told you to go home first... You saw me looking all lame...
Who cares about lame... What if you got seriously hurt！
But you go to that arcade a lot, right？ You don't want to be scared every time.
Just... just for that, you got hurt...
Thanks for walking me home. It's nothing serious, so don't worry about it.
Quit trying to look cool. But...
You were really cool. I thought, if I had a big brother, maybe this is what it'd be like. Really.
Hahaha... Having a violent little sister must be tough.
...Rinko's not your little sister, you know？
？ ...Well, obviously.
Yeah. As long as you know. ...See you！
(？ What was that about...)
Oh, it's this late already...
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, want to hit the arcade on the way home？
You sure love that place... Well, let's go！
We're here！ So, what am I gonna crush you at today？ Oh...
Hey, let's just go home. That guy from before is here...
...▲小早川＊▲, go on home first.
Why？ ...Wait, what are you thinking!?
Hey, let's settle this.
Sketchy Guy
You're the guy from before... Gutsy. Step outside!!
Guess I'm no match for him... Ow...
There's no way you'd beat a brute like that！ Are you stupid？ You're stupid！
Quit calling me stupid. It hurts my feelings.
You're weak, and if the staff hadn't called the cops, what would've happened？
But he won't be able to show his face there for a while, right？ You can play without being scared now.
Just... just for that... Idiot...
It's nothing serious, so don't worry about it.
Come on, being walked home by Rinko for once isn't so bad, right？
I guess. Thanks. Get home safe, okay？
...Hey, one question.
You said once that Rinko was like a little sister to you, right？
Rinko doesn't see it that way...
Sorry, I was only joking.
That's not what I mean... Never mind！ Idiot！
(How many times did she call me stupid today...)
Oh, it's this late already...
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, want to hit the arcade on the way home？
You sure love that place... Well, let's go！
We're here！ So, what am I gonna crush you at today？ Oh...
Hey, let's just go home. That guy from before is here...
Good grief... No choice, huh. ▲小早川＊▲, go on home first.
Why？ ...Wait, what are you thinking!?
Excuse me, hey！
Sketchy Guy
Oh, it's you from before！
Yeah. I heard my girlfriend kicked you. I'm really sorry about that.
If sorry cut it, we wouldn't need cops, punk！
...is what you'd say, right？ You've got the face for it... Sigh.
Ow... I had a feeling this would happen...
Are you okay...？ No, of course you're not.
There's no way sorry works on a gorilla like that.
Yeah. But he let it go. I had to settle it somehow. I'm the big brother, right？
Yeah... Thank you.
I'm fine from here. Thanks for walking me！
But it's all Rinko's fault...
It's no big deal, so don't worry. That stuff happens when you've got a violent little sister.
Hey... I'm not your sister.
I was joking.
Rinko's not joking. I don't want to be your sister...
Never mind！ Hehe, see you！
Yeah... See you.
